messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Issues with Distance 7 shapefile import
parts:
Hi Orla,

Did you bring the GIS file in via the Import Shape Wizard? (Under Tools
menu.) If not, give that a try. If you did already, then please can
you send me your Distance project file (use File | Export project...) to
make a zip file and also the shapefile you're using, I'll be happy to
take a look and see if I can diagnose the problem. Once we've found it,
perhaps you can post the solution back to the list for others.

Cheers, Len Thomas
